mapper.insert: insert into dish (category_id, name, image, price, description, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{image}, #{price}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select:
select d.*, c.name as categoryName from dish d left join category c on d.category_id = c.id
d.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
d.category_id = #{categoryId}
order by create_time desc
